newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends unchanged at Friday's 14.08 rgt.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends unchanged at Friday's 14.08 rgt.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended unchanged at Friday's 14.08 ringgit ($5.61) a kg after both sellers and buyers decided to close their deals at the opening level, traders said.

"The market was steady. There were almost equal buying and selling interest," a trader said. They noted an opening bid of 125 tonnes against seller of 129 tonnes. Final turnover was 125 tonnes, compared with Friday's 115 tonnes with local, Japanese and European buying seen at low level.
The local price premium over London was $45 a tonne vs $85 on Monday. -Tan Lee Lee (603-275-6834) ($1=2.5110 rgt)
